title: Settle OAuth discovery for a built-in provider, or record it as documentation-only
statement: Determine whether saved OAuth authentication can be discovered for a BUILT-IN provider using a fabricated credential, or whether it requires a real interactive `/login` against a real subscription. If the latter, run it once manually, retain the sanitised outcome as single-instance evidence labelled as such, and keep it out of CI — the treatment section 15.3 already gives live paid-provider tests. Answers QST-0033.
notes: ⚠️ THE SPIKE'S NEGATIVE RESULT IS NOT EVIDENCE ABOUT OAUTH. A provider declared in models.json is composed with API-key auth only, so a stored OAuth credential for one never resolves — the model being unavailable says something about provider composition and nothing about the OAuth path. ⚠️ UNTIL THIS IS SETTLED, no acceptance criterion may be written as though the OAuth route were verified, and section 6.2 must keep saying so.
